spl_unclassified_section: For Oily / Problem Skin These hygienic, single-use purifying pads are specially formulated to support the daily skincare routine of adolescents with oily/acne prone skin. Each soft, non-woven pad is saturated with a unique, effective cleansing solution enriched with moisturizing components (Sodium PCA and Urea) to prevent over-drying; Purifying tree resins (Copaiba Balsam and Manuka oil) to support the pore-purifying action of Salicylic Acid , and reduce excess oiliness and impurities. Allantoin and Vitamin B5 (Panthenol) contribute to a calming, conditioning effect, leaving the skin smooth and fresh after use. Excellent for use at home, or on the go - whenever skin needs quick, hygienic support. Anna Lotan USA Inc. 16 Wheeling Ave Woburn, MA 01801. www.annalotanusa.com PRODUCT OF ISRAEL
indications_and_usage: Uses • For the treatment of acne.
warnings: Warnings For external use only. Allergy alert : do not use this product if you have a known allergy to Salicylic Acid. Do not use: • on damaged and broken skin. • on large areas of the body. When using this product • skin irritation and dryness are more likely to occur if you use another topical acne medication at the same time. If irritation occurs, use only one topical acne medication at a time. Keep out of reach of children • If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children • If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions • Thoroughly cleanse the skin before applying the product. • Using the pad, apply a thin layer to cover the entire affected area one to two times daily. • Wash hands thoroughly after application. • As excessive skin dryness may occur, begin with one application daily. Gradually, increase to two applications daily if needed or as directed by a physician. • If significant dryness or peeling develops, reduce use to once daily or every other day. • Do not leave the pad on prolonged contact with the skin. • Avoid contact with the eyes, lips, and other mucous membranes.
storage_and_handling: Other information • Keep tightly closed • store in a cool & dry place.
